summary: Frontend-only validation of BirdPulse v1.0.2 paywall redesign + review-prompt wiring on Metro web preview (375x667). All primary review items pass: paywall renders cleanly with correct hero/eyebrow/title and exactly the 4 specified benefits (no 'range maps'); close [X] is hidden for the first 3s (parent opacity=0, pointerEvents=none, disabled=true) then fades in (opacity=1, pointerEvents=auto); tapping X on web dismisses to /(tabs) without opening the Exit Reframe Drawer (correct, since annualPkg is null on web); /result renders without crash on both 1st and 2nd lifetime successful IDs, and the new StoreReview useEffect runs without producing any unhandled promise rejections or red-screen errors; tab navigation (Home, Collection) works. No console pageerrors. The 'Available in the mobile app' notice is correctly shown in place of plan cards on web (IS_RC_AVAILABLE=false), as the spec confirms is intentional.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. The Animated.View wrapping the close button passes pointerEvents as a prop (paywall.tsx:362). Reference: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:362

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Likely originates from theme shadows.glowPrimary used on .cta (paywall.tsx) and detailBtn (result.tsx). Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadows.glowPrimary)
Web warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing'. Expected on web; on native this is fine. No action required.

action_items: (Low priority) Migrate Animated.View `pointerEvents` prop to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` in paywall.tsx close-button wrapper to silence the deprecation warning on web.
(Low priority) Migrate the theme `shadows.glowPrimary` token to use `boxShadow` (or the modern shadow*Color/elevation pattern) to silence RN Web shadow deprecation warning.

(Optional regression) Add a `testID` (e.g. `bird-of-day-card`) on the Bird-of-the-Day card so future regression scripts can reliably tap into the Cooper's Hawk detail screen; in this iteration the text-based selector hit the overlay label and did not navigate, so the Cooper's Hawk → /bird/[id] regression remained INCONCLUSIVE via automation (visually the card is rendered; manual tap on device should still work).
critical_code_review_comments: paywall.tsx onClosePress correctly only opens the Exit Drawer when both `annualPkg && IS_RC_AVAILABLE` — on web this short-circuits to dismissPaywall, matching the spec.

result.tsx StoreReview effect is well-guarded: ref-based double-fire guard for StrictMode, persistent `hasRated` flag via markReviewRequested(), and try/catch that swallows errors so the result screen can never crash from review-prompt failures. shouldRequestReview only returns true when count===2, satisfying the 'once, on 2nd lifetime ID' rule.
state.ts recordSuccessfulIdentification is async-safe and uses an explicit default of 0; minor: a concurrent double-call could double-count but the hasRated guard makes that harmless.

paywall.tsx ctaLabel correctly falls back to 'Continue with [priceString] →' when no free trial is present, and the chevron lives in a separate <Ionicons> inside ctaInner (not concatenated into the string), which is the correct RN approach.
seed_data_creation: None. Used a synthetic /result payload via URL query string (American Robin) to exercise the StoreReview useEffect path without needing the real Photo/Sound ID pipeline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview: tapping the [X] becomes possible only after ~3.5s (CLOSE_REVEAL_DELAY_MS=3000 + 400ms fade). On web, IS_RC_AVAILABLE is false so plan cards, paywall-trust-line, paywall-subscribe-button, and paywall-exit-drawer are not rendered — only the 'Available in the mobile app' notice. Exit drawer & purchase flow require iOS device QA. Onboarding/paywall storage flags persist in web localStorage and may auto-redirect first launches to /onboarding → /paywall; advance through onboarding (5 'Continue' taps) and dismiss the paywall before testing tab nav. For Cooper's Hawk regression add a testID to the BotD card to make automation reliable.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions found. Console-level warnings (shadow* props, pointerEvents prop, useNativeDriver) are RN-Web compatibility noise and do not affect functionality on web or native. The 500 from /api/wiki/summary is backend (out of scope this round) and is handled gracefully by result.tsx's .catch(() => {}) — the hero image falls through to seed/silhouette correctly.
